doc: Zonal means of continentality (300 km smoothing) and of deck_window x deck_strength in the 15 bands x in [k/6, (k+1)/6) of x = |lat| / phi_H (both hemispheres together; a row with x >= 15/6 is in no band). Float32 field means in float32: default tolerance, measured worst difference against the float64 chain 2.2e-8. The coast threshold is at least 1e-4 from every texel (asserted). Hadley 60 at width 128: x reaches only 1.45, so bands 9..14 (x >= 1.5) contain no row and their means are NaN. The case pins NaN, not 0 or a panic. Bands [9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14] contain no row: both outputs are NaN there (numpy: the mean of an empty slice, a RuntimeWarning, NaN) and NaN equals NaN in the comparison; every other band is finite. params.constants lists the module constants and the inline numbers the function reads (a port copies them from its own source and may assert that they equal these).
